# API Documentation Requirements Checklist: Swagger/OpenAPI Documentation

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency and measurability of documentation requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard
**Audience / timing**: Author and peer reviewer; pre-implementation requirements review.
**Focus**: Contract completeness and compatibility, with documentation UI functionality and dependency constraints.

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist`. These items assess written requirements, not application implementation. Items are intentionally unchecked for reviewer assessment.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all six existing task operations explicitly enumerated with their documentation obligations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are parameter types, requiredness, permitted query values and defaults specified for every applicable operation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are create, content-update and completion body requirements separately defined, including nullability, omission and unknown-property rejection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are all Todo properties, response envelopes, success statuses and response headers included in documentation requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Are the shared error envelope and operation-specific error statuses, codes and headers comprehensively required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Are trimming, blank-description normalization and the distinction between pre-normalization input and normalized responses clearly described? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK007 Are title and description length limits explicitly stated as applying after trimming rather than to unnormalized input? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Are due-date requirements precise about the write-time clock, strict future comparison and exact stored-instant exception? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Is schema reuse “wherever practical” bounded by explicit justification and consistency obligations for exceptions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK010 Are documentation addresses and the selected description version recorded in durable feature artifacts, rather than remaining chat-only choices? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-013, §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the selected browse-only interface requirements consistent with the specification’s current allowance for optional request submission? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §FR-014, §Assumptions; conversation decision: browse only]
- [x] CHK012 Are local asset delivery and offline-after-installation expectations recorded consistently with documentation availability in both application modes? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-013; conversation decision: local assets]
- [x] CHK013 Are descending order, completed-task filtering and soft-deletion descriptions consistent across the specification and inherited contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 Are unauthenticated access requirements consistent across task operations and documentation, without introducing hypothetical credentials or 401/403 responses? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK015 Are existing architecture and behavior preservation requirements compatible with the documented boundaries for necessary integration changes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Is the denominator for complete operation coverage explicitly fixed at the six existing task operations? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK017 Are the representative contract scenarios sufficiently identified to make zero-discrepancy acceptance reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are the applicable regression acceptance gates clearly identified rather than left as an undefined subset of existing checks? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK019 Are Swagger automated/E2E/WCAG/Orca exclusions and the permitted static/type/lint/build verification boundary explicitly defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Constitution §VII]
- [x] CHK020 Is the documentation-only consumer task stated with an observable outcome and without requiring source-code knowledge? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are primary contract-discovery and browser-documentation journeys covered in both development and built application modes? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK022 Are documentation failure, unavailable-description and recovery expectations defined or explicitly delegated to standard interface behavior? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §User Story 2, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK023 Are coexistence requirements for frontend fallback routing and unrelated unknown API paths explicitly stated? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Are no-data-mutation requirements explicit for documentation browsing and illustrative examples? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are unknown fields, system-managed fields, empty updates, invalid identifiers and repeated or unsupported query values covered by documentation requirements? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-003–FR-005]
- [x] CHK026 Are malformed JSON, oversized bodies and unsupported content types distinguished in the required failure descriptions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK027 Are absent versus empty field-error maps, historical response dates, retained overdue dates and repeated deletion addressed explicitly? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK028 Are create-only ordinal exhaustion, create/content-update retry scope and unchanged unmatched-method behavior clearly distinguished? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Is the user-approved Swagger exception scoped clearly so that existing Todo UI accessibility obligations remain unchanged? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Constitution §VII]
- [x] CHK030 Are documentation privacy requirements explicit about external validation, remote assets and disclosure of internal or sensitive information? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012; conversation decision: local assets]
- [x] CHK031 Are local single-user operational assumptions and exclusions of public hosting, authentication and infrastructure expansion clearly bounded? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 Are proposed dependency purposes, alternatives, approval state and any required constitutional amendment clearly distinguished from approved feature requirements? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-018, §Assumptions; Constitution §III, §X]
- [x] CHK033 Are manually represented transformations and dynamic business rules identified as documentation limitations with explicit consistency obligations? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-016, §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK034 Is the absence of persisted planning artifacts explicitly distinguished from completed planning, with outstanding decisions traceable before implementation? [Gap, Spec §FR-018–FR-019; plan.md absent]
- [x] CHK035 Is precedence between current behavior and stale contract prose explicit without authorizing unrelated behavior changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, §Assumptions]
